records.prompt:
Use the attached LLM Wiki concept board as STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a new single-page high-fidelity native Windows WPF app design for the KNOWLEDGE READING PAGE. This is the precise visual implementation target, not a collage, poster, infographic, browser, or code screenshot. One entire flat front-facing app window, approximately 1440x900 landscape. All visible UI simplified Chinese, crisp readable Microsoft YaHei/Segoe UI. No outside title or margins, no secondary mockup panels.

Replicate the reference's refined dark Windows Fluent look: neutral charcoal layered surfaces, subtle cool grey 1px borders, restrained 8px corners, line icons, Windows blue, clear hierarchy, elegant whitespace. Absolutely no purple, glow or hero wallpaper. Important: high-contrast light tree text and icons, custom full-width blue selected row, no black text or white selected rectangles in dark theme. Beautiful finished desktop productivity product, not default WPF widgets.

Geometry:
52px integrated top title/toolbar: left blue book mark "LLM Wiki", library selector "产品研究 ▾", centered current-library filename search "查找当前库文件…   Ctrl+K", right help icon and standard Windows window controls. Left app navigation ~208px, fixed, beneath titlebar: "知识" selected in subdued deep blue row with cyan/blue narrow leading indicator and white icon/text; "资料", "整理" with small badge "3"; bottom separator and "连接与分享", "知识库设置", "应用设置", "使用帮助". Bottom statusbar 28px.
Main content to right uses two columns: knowledge directory ~246px and wide reading canvas. Directory has title "知识目录" with small collapse icon, search "筛选知识目录…", polished line-tree rows height36 with light legible text. Selected row "知识首页" full-width muted blue #174B72 and white text, slim left blue indicator. Expanded group "概念" includes "知识库" and "整理流程"; "实体" has "LLM Wiki"; lower groups "资料摘要", "问题分析", "综合分析", "对比分析". No generic black folder glyphs. Selection stays blue even when reading pane focused.

Reading canvas:
A SINGLE integrated article header. Main title "产品概览" 26px, small path breadcrumb "知识首页 / 产品概览" and restrained badge "只读". Right secondary buttons "刷新" and icon "更多". Do not repeat a second file title/card. No "已保存" in readonly page. No giant extra "知识" title above article. No implementation explanations.
Directly below header, a slim informative strip "3 项资料变更尚未整理" with right link "去整理", not a large alert. Under it a reading surface with subtle border, large comfortable inset 32px and content width around700px, no nested cards within cards.
Article begins with a two-line introductory paragraph, NOT another "产品概览" heading: "将分散的原始资料整理为可追溯、可维护的知识。" and "资料保留原格式，整理过程由外部 AI 完成。"
Small source chips row "来源" chips "需求说明.docx" and "使用约定.md", clickable-looking.
Section heading "工作方式", body text with real short Chinese content. A restrained horizontal row of three compact steps "添加资料 → 整理知识 → 核对结果", no heavy illustration.
Section heading "核心约定", three nicely spaced bullet lines:
"源文件保持原格式，不生成 Markdown 副本。"
"整理完成后逐项核对，保留来源引用。"
"资料可移入回收站，误删后可以恢复。"
Section heading "相关知识", two slim inline blue links "知识库结构" and "日常整理流程".
At reading area's right a narrow discreet on-page contents column headed "本页目录" with "工作方式" active blue, "核心约定", "相关知识". It is within same reading layout, not a separate huge card. Typography paragraph14px equivalent, lineheight~24px; headings18px. Empty space belongs to reading canvas not a large bordered empty editor.
Footer status "产品研究 · 目录正常" left, "3 项待整理" center, "浏览分享：关闭    本机任务：空闲" right. No fabricated statistics, charts, user profile, chat, saved indicator, redundant "打开文件夹/复制路径" buttons in main header; low-frequency actions are in more menu.
Aim for near-production pixel-polished visual fidelity to the reference, high legibility and balanced spacing. This is a single knowledge-page design target image.

records.generation_prompt:
Create ONE professional UI component specification concept board for LLM Wiki, using the attached app as visual style reference. It must show the application's MODAL DIALOGS, SNACKBARS and INLINE INFOBARS in BOTH dark and light theme. High-resolution landscape approx 2400x1500, crisp legible Simplified Chinese. This is a design-system board, not one live app with simultaneous dialogs. Six equal demonstration tiles: top row dark, bottom row light. Three columns: 未保存更改 / 永久删除 / 通知与页内提醒. Small overall title "LLM Wiki · 弹框与通知规范", subtitle "各状态独立展示，非同时弹出". No perspective, no devices, no purple, no chat, no gradients/glow. Match reference's restrained Windows Fluent, blue primary actions, thin borders, 8-12px corners, accurate input and focus styles. Small neutral dividers and generous spacing.

Col1, both themes, matching layout:
A centered content dialog over subtly dimmed small abstract app background. Title exact "还有未保存的更改". Body "离开前，请处理以下文件的修改。" Below two file rows "会议纪要.md" and "purpose.md", each small document outline icon and "未保存". Footer from left to right: text button "放弃更改", secondary bordered "留在此处" (safe keyboard focus outline), blue primary "保存并继续". Footer aligned right, padding24, height36 buttons. No nested dialog, no giant icons. Dark surface #20272F, text #F3F4F6, secondary #B4BFCC; light surface white, text #17212F, secondary #526171.

Col2, both themes:
Content dialog title "永久删除知识库", understated danger icon. Body "将永久删除“产品研究”的全部资料、知识和回收站，无法通过本应用恢复。" Label "输入知识库名称以确认", EMPTY text input with placeholder "产品研究". Footer left "取消" (safe focus), right "永久删除此知识库" visibly DISABLED with readable grey text because field empty. Do NOT show active red delete button in this empty-input state. No token or password fields. Width slightly larger than col1, natural body wrap, no excessive whitespace.

Col3, both themes:
Stack four SEPARATE preview specimens with small labels, never implying actual data:
1. Short success Snackbar with small green check icon, text "会议纪要.md 已保存", close icon. Minimal dark/light card, no full neon green.
2. Undo Snackbar with small blue file icon, text "已移入回收站，可恢复", action "撤销", close icon. Subtle quiet bottom timer indicator optional.
3. Error Snackbar with small red error icon, text "复制失败：剪贴板暂不可用", action "重试复制", close icon.
4. Persistent inline warning InfoBar with amber icon, multiline text "文件已保存，变更记录未完成", action "重试登记"; no automatic dismissal/timer.
Keep card text contrast strong, buttons blue links legible on dark and light backgrounds. Safe focus visible, disabled text not overly faint. Main dark and light surfaces use the same blue hue #0078D4. Theme labels "深色" / "浅色" visible at tile corners. All text exact, no fabricated feature additions. Board should be a practical mockup directly realizable with WPF-UI 4.3 ContentDialog, Snackbar and InfoBar plus project templates.
